content:
Nice: the rules match the original game, and I couldn't break the referee. I checked the move generator against an independent implementation (same legal moves, pushes and wins on 40,000 positions from random games) and played the longest case (swap in both rounds, 2 x 110 moves) without any SDK error. 

A few minor suggestions:

- The default stub output is an illegal move. 3 7 3 3 0 -1 makes both moves on dark boards ((3,7) and (3,3) are both on dark boards). 3 7 4 3 0 -1 is legal for black's first move. A comment telling players to print one of the given legal moves would help too.

- The statement doesn't say that a timeout or an invalid action loses the whole match, including a round already won. The referee does this (score -1), so one sentence in the "Match" section would make it clear.

- The bosses won't compile with newer GCC versions. CodinGame currently uses GCC 11.2, where they compile fine. With GCC 13, #pragma GCC target("popcnt") placed before the #includes fails with "inlining failed in call to 'always_inline' … target specific option mismatch", and all three Boss.cpp files fail to build. A compiler upgrade on CG would break the leagues. Putting the pragma after the standard #includes (or dropping it) fixes this; I checked that it builds with GCC 13.

(This comment was generated using the recently updated CG API :D)
updated with some polish, improved statement, timeline markers, might be ready to leave WIP soon
